sentences.text: Intake is a live flag: below baseline for 1 consecutive day, baseline read over 24 recent rated meals, about 50 h without a full meal; in cats, ≥48–72 h of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window.
Meals: 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days.
The trial diet, Cooper's Venison LID, from Sep 28, 2026, day 19 of 42, was not fed exclusively; no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping, not checked with the owner.
